raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Switch `deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_fp8mx_deterministic_config` from the HybridEP override back to the base recipe's NCCL EP stack, so it differs from `deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_fp8mx_config` only by the determinism settings.

# Changelog

- `perf_recipes/deepseek/gb300/deepseek_v3.py`: drop the `moe_flex_dispatcher_backend="hybridep"` / `moe_use_grouped_tensor=False` override, its TODO, and the HybridEP topology env vars (`NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN`, `NUM_OF_TOKENS_PER_CHUNK_COMBINE_API`, `NVLINK_DOMAIN_SIZE`, `USE_MNNVL`); add the base recipe's `NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH=1`.
- `tests/unit_tests/recipes/test_gb300_ncclep_perf_recipes.py`: assert the deterministic recipe uses the same `flex`/`ncclep` dispatcher and grouped tensor as the base recipe, carries no HybridEP env, and that its env is exactly the base env plus the determinism env.

## Validation
https://forge.coreweave.com/wandb/nvidia/determinism-zhiyul?nw=8qmmx6vkgfd

DeepSeek V3, 256x GB300 (64 nodes), MXFP8, TP1 PP2 EP32, GBS 4096, seq 4096, benchmark mock data, 50 iterations, `scripts/training/run_recipe.py`. A1 and A2 use this PR's deterministic recipe with `--deterministic`; B is the base (non-deterministic) recipe.

| Run | lm loss @50 | grad norm @50 |
|---|---|---|
| A1 (deterministic) | 8.120713 | 0.067 |
| A2 (deterministic) | 8.120713 | 0.067 |
| B (base) | 7.224594 | 0.770 |

- **Run-to-run determinism:** A1 and A2 report identical lm loss and grad norm on all 50 iterations (at logged precision).
- **Determinism cost**, step time over iterations 20-50 (n=31 each):

| | mean (ms) | median (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | 10876.0 | 10862.5 |
| A2 | 10991.4 | 10956.7 |
| A (avg) | 10933.7 | 10909.6 |
| B | 10200.3 | 10152.6 |
| **Cost (A vs B)** | **+7.19%** | **+7.46%** |

- No errors, skipped, or NaN iterations in any run.
- Lint: ruff check, import sort, and format (pre-commit pin v0.9.9) pass on both files.
- Unit tests: not run locally; left to CI.

**Open question:** B's loss separates from A's after about iteration 30 (8.12 vs 7.22 at iteration 50). One B run can't tell normal run-to-run variance from an effect of the determinism settings; a second non-deterministic run is the follow-up.

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests? (updated the existing deterministic-recipe unit test)
- [ ] Did you add or update any necessary documentation? (not needed: recipe internals only)
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

If you haven't finished some of the above items you can still open "Draft" PR.

# Additional Information

- Follow-up to #6440 (deterministic recipes); resolves the `TODO: revert back to NCCL EP` in the DSv3 GB300 deterministic recipe.

files.patch:
@@ -206,9 +206,6 @@ def deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_fp8mx_deterministic_config() -> ConfigCont
     :func:`~megatron.bridge.recipes.utils.determinism_utils.apply_determinism_overrides`.
     """
     cfg = deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_fp8mx_config()
-    # TODO: revert back to NCCL EP once the NCCL EP issue is fixed.
-    cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend = "hybridep"
-    cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor = False
     apply_determinism_overrides(cfg)
     # Keep process settings next to the recipe so users can see the exact benchmark environment.
     cfg.env_vars = {
@@ -223,11 +220,8 @@ def deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_fp8mx_deterministic_config() -> ConfigCont
         "TORCH_NCCL_AVOID_RECORD_STREAMS": 0,
         # NCCL user-buffer and launch settings.
         "NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE": 0,
-        # HybridEP topology for the target system.
-        "NUM_OF_HYBRID_EP_RANKS_PER_NVLINK_DOMAIN": 32,
-        "NUM_OF_TOKENS_PER_CHUNK_COMBINE_API": 128,
-        "NVLINK_DOMAIN_SIZE": 72,
-        "USE_MNNVL": 1,
+        # NCCL EP dispatcher mode and one GPU per rank.
+        "NCCL_EP_HT_EM_PULL_PUSH": 1,
         # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.
         "CUDNNFE_CLUSTER_OVERLAP_MARGIN": 8,
         "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,

@@ -155,11 +155,9 @@ def test_deepseek_v3_gb300_fp8mx_deterministic_is_base_plus_determinism_override
     assert cfg.model.cross_entropy_loss_fusion is False
     assert cfg.model.moe_router_aux_loss_fusion is False
     assert cfg.model.moe_router_fusion == base.model.moe_router_fusion
-    # HybridEP with the legacy grouped MLP until the NCCL EP path is deterministic.
-    assert cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == "hybridep"
-    assert cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor is False
-    assert cfg.env_vars.keys() >= HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES
-    assert cfg.env_vars.keys().isdisjoint(_NCCL_EP_ENV)
-    expected_env = {name: value for name, value in base.env_vars.items() if name not in _NCCL_EP_ENV}
-    expected_env.update({name: cfg.env_vars[name] for name in HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES})
-    assert cfg.env_vars == {**expected_env, **DETERMINISM_ENV_VAR_DEFAULTS, **_SSM_DETERMINISM_ENV}
+    # Same NCCL EP stack as the base recipe; only the determinism overrides differ.
+    assert cfg.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == base.model.moe_token_dispatcher_type == "flex"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == base.model.moe_flex_dispatcher_backend == "ncclep"
+    assert cfg.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor is base.model.moe_use_grouped_tensor is True
+    assert cfg.env_vars.keys().isdisjoint(HYBRID_EP_ENV_NAMES)
+    assert cfg.env_vars == {**base.env_vars, **DETERMINISM_ENV_VAR_DEFAULTS, **_SSM_DETERMINISM_ENV}
